gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-average: Chunky, ruler-straight, and a bit cheeky: that's Happy Monkey up top. Its line never swells or thins, and Average follows with a classic serif's slight reed-pen thickening and mouths left wide open.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-besley: Besley brings a dignified, editorial serif voice, with crossbars just a touch thinner than its stems. Happy Monkey sits above it with strokes that never vary in weight, so the heading looks blunt and the text looks drawn.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-biz-udpmincho: BIZ UDPMincho reads as traditional and refined, its thick strokes mild and its letters kept clear of each other. Happy Monkey's arches match its stems in weight, and that flat bold look makes the serif's modest shifts feel finer.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bona-nova: Happy Monkey draws a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts anywhere, which makes it the bolder, more playful voice. But Bona Nova, a text serif, does the quieter work, using the mild variation of a gently handled dip pen.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-bona-nova-sc: Refined is how Bona Nova SC feels, with gentle stroke modulation and small counters that never clog up. Happy Monkey's constant-width line plays against it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-brawler: Happy Monkey traces every letter with a line of constant weight, which gives the heading its bold, distinctive look. Brawler, a text serif, flows softly in comparison.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cactus-classical-: Cactus Classical Serif has an e opened wide. Its bowls shift gently in weight, so the body can be set a touch larger to let that softness show, while Happy Monkey's ruler-straight heading needs no such help.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-caudex: Caudex reads as authoritative and dignified, its thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick ones, like lines etched in glass. Happy Monkey's zero modulation is the sharper foil, and that gap in construction is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Happy Monkey has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, just a bold, ruler-straight line that stands out. Yet Chiron Sung HK is what holds the pair together, with pen-like bowls and wide-set curve ends that reward a close look.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cinzel: Happy Monkey leaves the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen, and it handles bold, distinctive display work best. But Cinzel, a text serif, carries the slight heft changes of carved stone, with loose tracking suited to calmer lines.
